title: Cooldown Button
summary: A button that waits longer after each attempt and shows why, so "Resend code" and retries aren't tapped repeatedly by accident.
description: Escalating cooldowns per attempt (30s, 60s, 120s) with a visible countdown and reason, and a lock once attempts run out. The deadline is kept in sessionStorage, so a refresh in the same tab keeps it; a new tab or cleared storage does not.
catches: Repeated taps on resend or retry, with a growing wait
Unclear waiting, by showing a countdown and the reason
Running out of attempts, with a clear locked message
Clicks before hydration, by staying inert until the saved state is restored
limits: UI only: a new tab, another device or cleared storage bypasses the cooldown
It reduces accidental repeats; it does not rate-limit or prevent double charges on its own
a11y: Stays focusable while waiting (aria-disabled instead of disabled)
aria-busy while pending and aria-describedby to the reason
Becoming ready is announced in an aria-live="polite" region
Errors and the exhausted message use role="alert"
server: Enforce rate limits and attempt counts on the server (per account and IP), and make paid actions idempotent.
